options.content:
# WoW Market
Auction average trends | Scan times in UTC

[Item charts](/d/profit-market?${__url_time_range}&${__all_variables}&kiosk) | [Compare materials](/d/profit-market-compare?${__url_time_range}&${__all_variables}&kiosk) | [24H](/d/profit-market-compare?from=now-24h&to=now&${__all_variables}&kiosk) | [7D](/d/profit-market-compare?from=now-7d&to=now&${__all_variables}&kiosk) | [30D](/d/profit-market-compare?from=now-30d&to=now&${__all_variables}&kiosk)

panels.title: ${subcategory:text} - Average price trends

targets.rawSql: SELECT observed_at AS time, SUM(average_copper*COALESCE(scan_count,1))/SUM(COALESCE(scan_count,1))/10000.0 AS value, COALESCE(item_name,'Item '||item_id::text)||' / '||average_method||CASE WHEN variant LIKE 'replicate:%' OR variant ~ '^[0-9]+:0:0:0$' THEN '' ELSE ' / '||variant END AS metric FROM reporting.average_history WHERE market_key IN (${market:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(class_id,-1) = ${category:sqlstring}::integer AND (${subcategory:sqlstring} = '-1' OR subclass_id = ${subcategory:sqlstring}::integer) AND metric=${method:sqlstring} AND item_id::text = ANY(ARRAY[${item:sqlstring}]::text[]) AND $__timeFilter(observed_at) GROUP BY observed_at,item_id,item_name,average_method,variant ORDER BY observed_at

panels.description: Only saved averages appear. Daily trimmed averages weight each completed full scan equally. Sampled listing averages are separate. Timestamps are UTC. Older daily rollups retain their latest observation time. Use the legend to hide or isolate materials. Each item keeps its own line.

list.name: market
list.label: Realm / market
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT market_key FROM reporting.price_history ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT market_key FROM reporting.price_history ORDER BY 1

list.name: category
list.label: Category
list.query: SELECT name AS __text,class_id::text AS __value FROM reporting.ah_categories ORDER BY CASE WHEN class_id=7 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,name
list.definition: SELECT name AS __text,class_id::text AS __value FROM reporting.ah_categories ORDER BY CASE WHEN class_id=7 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,name

list.name: subcategory
list.label: Subcategory
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text,'-1' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT subclass_name,subclass_id::text FROM reporting.price_history WHERE market_key IN (${market:sqlstring}) AND class_id=${category:sqlstring}::integer AND subclass_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT 'All' AS __text,'-1' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT DISTINCT subclass_name,subclass_id::text FROM reporting.price_history WHERE market_key IN (${market:sqlstring}) AND class_id=${category:sqlstring}::integer AND subclass_name IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

list.name: method
list.label: Average
list.query: Daily trimmed average : trimmed_mean,Sampled listing average : listing_vwap

list.name: page
list.label: Page
list.query: SELECT n::text FROM generate_series(1,GREATEST(1,(SELECT (count(DISTINCT item_id)+11)/12 FROM reporting.price_history WHERE market_key IN (${market:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(class_id,-1) = ${category:sqlstring}::integer AND (${subcategory:sqlstring} = '-1' OR subclass_id = ${subcategory:sqlstring}::integer)))::integer) n
list.definition: SELECT n::text FROM generate_series(1,GREATEST(1,(SELECT (count(DISTINCT item_id)+11)/12 FROM reporting.price_history WHERE market_key IN (${market:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(class_id,-1) = ${category:sqlstring}::integer AND (${subcategory:sqlstring} = '-1' OR subclass_id = ${subcategory:sqlstring}::integer)))::integer) n

list.name: item
list.label: Items
list.query: WITH items AS (SELECT COALESCE(max(item_name),'Item '||item_id::text) AS name,item_id::text AS id FROM reporting.price_history WHERE market_key IN (${market:sqlstring}) AND COALESCE(class_id,-1) = ${category:sqlstring}::integer AND (${subcategory:sqlstring} = '-1' OR subclass_id = ${subcategory:sqlstring}::integer) GROUP BY item_id ORDER BY 1,item_id LIMIT 12 OFFSET (GREATEST(1,${page:sqlstring}::integer)-1)*12) SELECT name AS __text,id AS __value FROM items UNION ALL SELECT 'Awaiting scanned averages','-1' WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM items)
